summary: The Yenching Academy is Peking University's residential college for an interdisciplinary master's in China Studies, taught in English in Beijing. About 120 scholars start each September, roughly three quarters of them from outside China, and every admitted scholar receives a fellowship that covers tuition, housing and a monthly stipend.
meta_title: Yenching Academy 2027: fully funded master's at Peking University
meta_description: Yenching Scholars 2027: a fully funded two-year master's in China Studies at Peking University. Apply by 30 November 2026. Eligibility, documents and costs.
covers: A room in the Yenching Academy residence on Peking University's campus, usually in a two-bedroom suite shared with one other scholar.
A monthly stipend and basic medical insurance.
One round trip between a city in your country of nationality and Beijing, and research and field-study costs.

The first-year fellowship goes to every admitted scholar. Scholars in good standing who stay in Beijing for the second year can apply for a second-year fellowship covering tuition, housing support, insurance and the stipend.
eligibility: A bachelor's degree in any field, or a final-year bachelor's student who will graduate by August 2027. Master's holders may also apply.

International applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. Applicants from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan use the same portal plus a Peking University supplementary application; mainland Chinese students apply through Peking University's graduate school.

An outstanding academic record, a strong interest in the interdisciplinary study of China, and a record of leadership and community engagement. You do not need to have studied China or Chinese before.
English: IELTS Academic 7.0, TOEFL iBT 100 or Cambridge English 185, taken after 1 September 2025. Native speakers and graduates of an English-taught degree are exempt.
how_to_apply: Create an account on the Yenching Academy admissions portal; applications for the 2027 cohort opened on 1 September 2026.
If you study at or graduated from one of the Academy's partner universities, go through your university's internal pre-selection first.
Submit the form, personal statement, research statement, CV, transcripts, diplomas and two academic recommendation letters by 9:00 am Beijing time on 30 November 2026.
International finalists are interviewed online in the winter or early spring, and final decisions come around April 2027. Peking University's acceptance letter follows in the summer.
watch_out: Recommendation letters must come from full or associate professors, or the equivalent, in your intended field of study.
There is no strict age limit, but apart from Zhuoyue Scholarship holders no one over 29 has been admitted; the average entrant is 23.
Peking University does not allow enrolment in another degree at the same time, so any degree you are studying for must be awarded by August 2027.
Only the first-year fellowship is guaranteed. The second-year fellowship is for scholars who stay in Beijing.
Test scores must be sent to the Academy directly by IELTS, TOEFL (code C488) or Cambridge; TOEFL Home Edition, MyBest scores and IELTS Online are not accepted.
costs: The Yenching Fellowship, for every admitted scholar
Housing in the Yenching Academy residence
The fellowship in year one; in year two, campus housing or a housing stipend for fellowship holders who stay in Beijing
Monthly stipend and basic medical insurance
One round trip between your home city and Beijing
The fellowship, with the fare estimated by the Academy; the city must be in your country of nationality
English test and sending your scores
documents: A personal statement of up to 750 words.
A statement of research interest of up to 1,500 words, excluding citations.
Your CV, official transcripts, and diplomas or certificates of enrolment.
Two academic recommendation letters, in Chinese or English, from full or associate professors in your intended field.
An IELTS, TOEFL or Cambridge score sent directly to the Academy, unless you are a native English speaker or hold an English-taught degree.

faq.q: Is the Yenching Academy fully funded?
faq.a: Yes for the first year: every admitted scholar receives the Yenching Fellowship, covering tuition, campus housing, a monthly stipend, basic medical insurance, one round trip to Beijing and research costs. Scholars in good standing who stay in Beijing for the second year can apply for a second-year fellowship.

faq.q: Do I need to speak Chinese?
faq.a: No. The programme is taught in English and you do not need to have studied China or Chinese before. A Chinese language course is compulsory for international scholars once they arrive; those who are already fluent can apply to take Chinese-taught courses instead.

faq.q: When is the Yenching Academy deadline for 2027?
faq.a: 9:00 am Beijing time on 30 November 2026, for international applicants and those from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan. Students at partner universities must first pass their own university's pre-selection.

faq.q: Which degree do Yenching Scholars receive?
faq.a: A two-year Peking University master's in China Studies, named after your research area: for example a Master of Law in China Studies for Politics and International Relations, or a Master of Economics in China Studies for Economics and Management.
